factors.name: Official household expansion weights
factors.equation: mean=sum(w*y)/sum(w); share=sum(w*I)/sum(w); regional means restrict sums to region
factors.applicability: Use supplied final positive household weights in extension. Published baseline remains unweighted.
factors.audit: Both releases unique IDs and all positive weights, see raw_release_checks.json. Official tracciato2013 row385;2021 row8. Not physical calibration.

factors.name: Compositional standardization
factors.path: No pre-existing qualified factor table located
factors.schema: Proposed target cell proportions p_ref(c),observed p_t(c)
factors.equation: standardized mean=sum_c p_ref(c)*mean_t(c); optional weight multiplier p_ref(c)/p_t(c)
factors.applicability: Only explicit supported cells with documented target/overlap. Not an official ISTAT supplied coefficient.
factors.audit: Separate from official weights; no new baseline fit or inferred existing factor.

factors.applicability: Descriptive only; not a row weight, prevalence ratio or energy calibration multiplier
factors.audit: Paperp6Table2 regional MANOVA and p7 exclusion of weights; centroid similarity does not establish prevalence equivalence.
